# Tournaments reference

Every cup is a 16-team knockout: 4 rounds, 6-minute matches. Lose once and the run ends.

| Cup | Difficulty | Squad requirement | Winner coins (every win) | First-win bonus (once per cup) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Cup | Amateur | None | 10,000 | Premium Gold Pack |
| Bronze Challenge | Professional | Bronze players only (XI and subs) | 20,000 | Bronze Special Pack |
| Silver Shield | Semi-Pro | Silver players only (XI and subs); Chemistry at least 75 | 15,000 | Silver Special Pack |
| Champions Trophy | World Class | None | 24,000 | Rare Players Pack |
| Brazil Cup | World Class | At least 7 Brazilian starters | 20,000 | Mega Pack + Carnival David Luiz |

## Match rewards

Each tournament match pays the [difficulty](difficulty.md) coins and XP for the cup's difficulty, plus one untradeable pack from the Seasons match-pack table of the division listed here.

| Difficulty | Pack table of division | Win pack | Draw pack | Loss pack |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beginner | 10 | Premium Bronze | Bronze | Bronze |
| Amateur | 8 | Silver | Premium Bronze | Bronze |
| Semi-Pro | 7 | Silver | Premium Bronze | Bronze |
| Professional | 5 | Premium Silver | Silver | Premium Bronze |
| World Class | 3 | Gold | Premium Silver | Silver |
| Legendary | 2 | Premium Gold | Gold | Premium Silver |
| Ultimate | 1 | Premium Gold | Gold | Premium Silver |
